messages:
alex: starting RC-2026.2 origination - artifacts ready at gs://redwood-ci/rcs/2026.2.tgz, requesting release pin and staging smoke run

devops-bot: build rc-2026.2 (build-812) uploaded :package:
artifact: gs://redwood-ci/rcs/2026.2.tgz
sha256: 3b7f4c2d9a8e0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5

priya: grabbing artifact to staging cluster now. doing `sha256sum`
qa-liz: quick heads up - staging KV cache needs warm before traffic. suggest run kv-warm job (30m) after deploy

alex: agreed. plan: pin -> deploy to staging -> kv-warm for 20m -> smoke tests -> canary 3% 20m -> ramp. pin request will include rollback window.

devops-bot: pin created by alex -> pin-id: pin-rc-6423. awaiting approval to promote

priya: sha mismatch on initial pull: local 9a8b7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8 != bot sha. re-downloading and recheck

qa-liz: also seeing that staging node group sg-stg-03 reports image digest different from artifact tag, might be stale cache on image registry

priya: re-pulled via `cictl pull --artifact gs://redwood-ci/rcs/2026.2.tgz --force` now sha matches bot: 3b7f4c2d9a8e0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5

alex: approving pin -> executing promote with kv-warm step
```
/deploy promote --pin pin-rc-6423 --stage staging --kv-warm 20m --smoke smoke-suite:v2
```

devops-bot: staging deploy started. kv-warm job queued. smoke tests will run after warm.

qa-liz: smoke tests running... tailing results. hitting a consistent assertion failure in chat-handler tests: `expected 200 got 503` in 3/12 runs

priya: checking logs, see transient 'connection refused' to redis from worker pool around 14:12:03 UTC

alex: pausing further promotion. @infra and @eng-runtime please investigate redis connection flaps on staging group sg-stg-03

oncall-sheriff: marking RC on hold. if smoke can't pass in next 30m we'll abort pin and roll artifacts back to candidate queue. I'm ready to abort manually if error rate persists or if 5xx pattern emerges.

devops-bot: smoke run failed -> smoke-suite:v2 -> 9 failed, 3 passed :x:

priya: ran a quick `kubectl describe pod` - one node showed OOMKilled on redis-proxy sidecar, restarted and rejoined 2m later. suspects: memory pressure from kv-warm concurrent jobs

qa-liz: kv-warm concurrency might be too high - current job count 8. suggest reducing to 2 and re-run smoke

alex: good catch. dropping concurrency and re-running kv-warm for 15m before another smoke. hold pin until pass.

devops-bot: kv-warm requeued with concurrency=2. smoke tests scheduled after warm.

[15m later]

qa-liz: smoke tests now: 12/12 passed :white_check_mark: p90 latency within baseline, no 5xxs observed in smoke window

priya: staging metrics look stable. ready for canary. recommended canary plan: 3% for 20m -> 25% for 10m -> 100%

oncall-sheriff: approve canary schedule. I will monitor first 10m at canary 3%. abort if error rate > 0.6% or any host OOM recurrence

alex: promoting to canary in prod with tag rc-2026.2. issuing promote command now:
```
/deploy promote --pin pin-rc-6423 --canary 3% --canary-duration 20m --tag rc-2026.2
```

devops-bot: Promotion started. canary 3% -> routing configured. canary hosts: 6

[8m into canary]

priya: seeing a spike of 5xx on 2 of 6 hosts; pattern: gRPC upstream timeout to model-serving (liveness ok, requests queuing)

qa-liz: spike correlates with sustained tokenization CPU spike on those hosts; CPU throttling on shared nodepool noted in k8s events

oncall-sheriff: initiating abort. triggering immediate rollback to stable-2026.1 and taking canary down.

alex: acknowledged. abort command issued

devops-bot: rollback executed by oncall-sheriff. traffic restored to stable-2026.1. canary aborted. incident INC-2026-078 opened for canary OOM/timeout spike.

priya: collecting heap and cpu profiles from affected hosts, will attach to incident. tagging eng-runtime for kernel/allocator analysis and infra for nodepool autoscaling rules

alex: blocking further promotions for this RC until incident triage. will draft a short postmortem and add RC-2026.2 to the next release issue board with status "blocked". cc @product for release expectation changes.

qa-liz: note for next attempt: kv-warm concurrency default to 2, ensure nodepool autoscaler buffer >= 20% before canary.

oncall-sheriff: closing thread for now. keep updates on INC-2026-078.
